findings.evidence: In handleBulkMigrateGameAssets, supabase.from("game_characters").select("id, game_id, name, default_icon_url").order("name", { ascending: true }) fetches rows in a single unpaginated request without a server-side filter on unmigrated default_icon_url values.
findings.impact: Non-blocking at current catalog scale, but once total game_characters across all games exceed PostgREST's default 1,000-row response cap, unmigrated characters ordered after row 1,000 would be omitted from a single bulk migration pass.
findings.recommendation: Paginate the game_characters query with .range(from, to) loops or add a server-side filter for non-null default_icon_url values not yet pointing to the game-assets public prefix before the catalog approaches 1,000 characters.

findings.evidence: pendingAssetMigrationCount sums games.filter(needsGameIconMigration).length and characters.filter((character) => needsGameAssetMigration(character.default_icon_url)).length, where characters in AdminPage state holds only the currently selected character-tab game's characters.
findings.impact: Cosmetic badge count inaccuracy only: if unmigrated character icons exist solely in games other than the active character-tab game, the bulk migration button omits the (N) count suffix, although the button remains enabled and handleBulkMigrateGameAssets queries all game_characters from the database on click.
findings.recommendation: Optionally compute a global unmigrated character count via a lightweight count query or clarify in a tooltip that the badge count reflects all games plus the currently selected game's loaded characters.
